description: When a Bookkeeping setup or Client bookkeeping settings form is submitted, saves the answers to Knowledge (Bookkeeping/settings.json and Bookkeeping/Clients/<client>.json), finds the client’s Xero organisation, and creates the client’s inbox folder. When a Which client is this for? form is submitted, files the bill under the client chosen (setting the Xero organisation it’s addressed to up as a new client when asked), so Process bill takes it from there, and remembers the name it was addressed to.
